title: Calibration-with-Graduation-Trigger Pattern
definition: The single decision-structure the five Cycle 019 ADRs (094–098) each instantiate: workflow point + calibration mechanism + tier classification + audit-bearing artifact + graduation trigger (C1). Also applied by ADR-083 (Cycle 017) and ADR-091 (Cycle 018). Compresses to one Pattern record plus per-application Substrate entries without audit-substance loss, provided the Substrate is auditable. Recurs as methodology vocabulary across cycles; the five-ADR clustering at one level does not recur (Grounding Loop 4), so its topology-level diagnostic value is single-cycle evidence and it inherits the kitchen-sink caveat (C7).
product_origin: "middle of the road choices as opposed to one big bold choice" (Solo Developer, theater metaphor, Cycle 019 DECIDE gate)

links.note: the Pattern record is the Substrate form of this concept
